body.name: Hurricane Harvey
body.summary: Harvey flooded 154,170 Harris County homes; only 36% were insured, and nearly half were outside the 100- and 500-year floodplains. 36 Harris County deaths.

body.name: Tax Day Flood
body.summary: 12-16 inches of rain in 12 hours; about 9,820 structures flooded and 7 deaths in Harris County.

body.name: Tropical Storm Imelda
body.summary: About 8,200 homes flooded across 4 counties; 2 Harris County deaths and at least 1,700 rescues.

body.name: June 2026 flash flood
body.summary: Downtown flooding on June 15, 2026: cars stranded under bridges, UH-Downtown closed, state disaster declaration.
